title: Clarity and Its Price
subtitle: What comes after purity
text: Full purity is not the end of the path. It is a threshold. Beyond it, Our Lady offers Clarity: a deeper attunement and a sharper sense of what is clean. At Resolute, Clarity 75, she grants Pale Intercession. This Still Art calls a small defensive fragment of her attention when an Unstained practitioner is endangered. It is not her complete arrival. As Clarity reaches its final stage, her voice changes, and the price of her full attention remains unclear.
